description: Set Nick's three notes and gave the fourth answer.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Reported the parish, forbade the ale after six, and gave the third answer.
name: George Bryan

description: Not at the table. Named in the health, and not answered.
name: John Heminges

description: Sang three notes under the note, and stopped.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Asked about the laugh, and then about the fairy, and tried the feet.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Carved, and gave the first answer, and called the table back to the meat.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Drank the grocer's health and gave the second answer.
name: Will Kemp

description: Kept the four answers from settling, named about ten, and showed the run.
name: William Shakespeare
